chmod Calculator

Tick rwx boxes for user/group/other — or type 755 — and see octal, symbolic, and the chmod command live.

ReadWriteExecute
User
Group
Other

📖 How to use

  1. Tick the rwx boxes, or type an octal/symbolic value.
  2. All three representations update live.
  3. Copy the generated chmod command.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it handle setuid/setgid/sticky?

Yes — setuid, setgid, and the sticky bit are included and shown as the 4th octal digit.

Can I type an octal number?

Type any 3- or 4-digit octal (e.g. 644) and the checkboxes update instantly.

Can I paste symbolic notation?

Yes — paste something like rwxr-xr-x and the octal value appears.

Does it show the chmod command?

The exact shell command (e.g. chmod 755 file) is shown for copy-paste.
